skill.name: ux-audit
skill.description: Perform structured UX audits for pages, components, and product flows using heuristic evaluation and usability review methods.
skill.summary: Audit product interfaces with heuristic scores and prioritized UX recommendations.
skill.author: Dami-Randle

content.value_statement: Teams miss usability issues before release. This skill guides structured UX audits with scores, critical issues, and prioritized recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates pages, components, and features against Nielsen usability heuristics.
Checks visual hierarchy, grouping, whitespace, and scan order.
Reviews interaction feedback, loading states, empty states, and clickable elements.
Assesses copy clarity, labels, terminology, and action text.
Formats results with scores, critical issues, recommendations, and positive patterns.
limitations: Does not run automated accessibility tests or browser instrumentation.
Requires screenshots, page descriptions, prototypes, or product context.
Cannot replace moderated user testing, analytics, or customer research.
Does not implement design or code changes for the user.

use_cases.title: Review a Feature Before Release
use_cases.description: Find usability blockers and quick improvements before a product launch.

use_cases.title: Improve a Design Review
use_cases.description: Turn subjective feedback into structured findings with priorities and rationale.

use_cases.title: Prepare Engineering Fixes
use_cases.description: Convert interface issues into prioritized recommendations with estimated effort.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Single Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for one screen or page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ux-audit skill to review this page. Evaluate heuristics, visual hierarchy, interactions, and content. Return scores, critical issues, and recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for a reusable interface component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this component for usability. Check labels, states, feedback, error handling, and consistency. Include positive patterns and prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a User Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this user flow from entry to completion. Identify friction, unclear status, recovery gaps, and missing guidance. Prioritize issues by user impact.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Release Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit with product goals and constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this feature using the provided goals, users, and release constraints. Rank P0 to P2 usability risks and recommend fixes with effort estimates.

output_examples.input: Audit a new onboarding page before release.
output: Summary Score: Good. The structure is clear, but progress feedback is weak.
Critical Issue: Users may not know whether account setup is complete.
Recommendation: Add a visible progress indicator and a clear completion state.

output_examples.input: Review a settings form with save and error states.
output: Heuristic Concern: System status is unclear after saving changes.
Key Issue: Error messages appear far from the affected fields.
Recommendation: Place inline validation beside each field and keep a persistent save result message.

output_examples.input: Evaluate checkout flow usability for mobile users.
output: Summary Score: Fair. The flow has clear steps, but recovery paths are limited.
Critical Issue: Users cannot easily edit shipping details after payment review.
Recommendation: Add editable review sections and preserve entered data after validation errors.

best_practices: Provide screenshots, user goals, and target audience details before the audit.
Ask for severity, priority, and effort so recommendations are actionable.
Review the positive patterns as well as the critical issues.
anti_patterns: Do not request a full product audit without sharing specific screens or flows.
Do not treat heuristic scores as a replacement for user research.
Do not ask for visual polish only when the goal is usability analysis.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits pages, components, features, and flows for usability issues and improvement opportunities.

faq.question: Does it use Nielsen heuristics?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill evaluates work against Nielsen usability heuristics and related UX best practices.

faq.question: Can it review screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review screenshots when the user provides the image and enough product context.

faq.question: Does it test accessibility compliance?
faq.answer: No. It can note obvious accessibility concerns, but it does not run WCAG compliance testing.

faq.question: What output should users expect?
faq.answer: Users should expect a summary score, heuristic scores, critical issues, recommendations, and positive patterns.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Product managers, designers, and engineering leads can use it before releases or design reviews.
